failure_clusters.does_not_prove: Does not prove that simply tightening the initial stop-loss to 0.75R will improve net R, as it may stop out trades that would have eventually recovered to be profitable.
evidence: Gross loss of 109.09 R across 69 trades where MAE went deeper than -0.75R.
This cluster represents the vast majority of the strategy's total gross loss of 115.43 R.

failure_clusters.does_not_prove: Does not prove that a break-even stop trigger at 0.50R will not prematurely exit trades that would have gone on to hit larger profit targets.
evidence: Gross loss of 30.09 R across 24 trades that reached an MFE of at least 0.50R but ultimately ended in a loss.

hypotheses.falsification_test: Compare any new candidate against this baseline; if the candidate does not outperform the baseline net R, reject the candidate.
hypotheses.why: Maintains the current strategy baseline to serve as a control group during evaluation.

hypotheses.falsification_test: Replay the strategy excluding short regime trades. If the out-of-sample net R improvement is less than 5 R or if the profit factor does not improve, falsify the hypothesis.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Exclude short regime from entry signals.
hypotheses.why: Candidate 1 in the filter screen shows that excluding the short regime improves net R by +12.01 R in W1, +11.54 R in W2, and +1.60 R in W3, showing robust out-of-sample durability.

hypotheses.falsification_test: Simulate the break-even trigger on historical intratrade path data. If the reduction in gross losses is offset by a larger reduction in gross profits (due to premature exits), falsify the hypothesis.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Implement a break-even stop trigger once trade MFE reaches 0.50R.
hypotheses.why: The favorable_then_loss_mfe_ge_0_50R cluster accounts for 30.09 R of gross losses. Protecting capital once a trade goes 0.50R in profit will eliminate these round-trip losses.
